544:t_2:171.en:
$$レナード$$
「She is the point where cause and effect converge. You could say she exists as she is now because this world went wrong, and...」

544:t_2:172.en:
$$レナード$$
「You could also say this world went wrong because she exists.」

544:t_2:174.en:
$$レナード$$
「In the deepest part of these ruins, $$千鳥かなめ$$ will meet a ghost. Inevitably.」

544:t_2:175.en:
$$レナード$$
「There she will merge with the power to put an end to history.」

544:t_2:177.en:
$$レナード$$
「A keystone that creates a world with no past, future, or present... She will become the linchpin, just as her name says.」

544:t_2:178.en:
$$宗介$$
「It makes no sense. What are you talking about?」

544:t_2:179.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm talking about the $$オムニ・スフィア$$ and the Whispers. The world's confusion began in this very place.」

544:t_2:184.en:
$$かなめ$$
(...The deeper I go, the stranger I feel...)

544:t_2:185.en:
$$かなめ$$
(If I don't focus my mind straight ahead, I'll lose my sanity...)

544:t_2:186.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you all right, $$カナメ$$?」

544:t_2:187.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, $$テッサ$$... Do we really have to go?」

544:t_2:188.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We have to do something about this place before $$アマルガム$$ can use it.」

544:t_2:189.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Is there really that much here?」

544:t_2:190.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...It is a power that, if mishandled, would do nothing but toy with the fates of people all over the world.」

544:t_2:191.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I suspect $$レナード$$ only pretended to serve the Empire because using this can overturn the situation.」

544:t_2:192.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Is that what's causing this strange feeling too?」

544:t_2:193.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... It is probably not running now, but this is the influence of Dr. $$ヴァロフ$$'s research apparatus ahead.」

544:t_2:194.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The influence of a device that's stopped...?」

544:t_2:195.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The mental waves it emitted 18 years ago, when it was running at full power, have carried all the way to this era.」

544:t_2:198.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Back when the world was still unstable from the $$大時空震動$$, the thing that would set the course of the world called the $$ＡＤＷ$$... and of this world now... began here.」

544:t_2:199.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm starting to understand... What lies ahead of us...」

544:t_2:201.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... The forbidden realm humanity stepped into to control the spacequake... in other words, $$次元力$$...」

544:t_2:203.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Controlling $$次元力$$... and amplifying mental waves for that purpose...」

544:t_2:204.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Through countless human experiments, it came close to completion.」

544:t_2:205.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But during a full-power test 18 years ago, $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ went out of control...」

544:t_2:206.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All of $$ヤムスク１１$$ was mentally contaminated, the city fell into ruin, and the land came to reject any intrusion from outside.」

544:t_2:207.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So that's why this city ended up like this...」

544:t_2:208.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The mental waves radiated through the $$オムニ・スフィア$$ were of several kinds.」

544:t_2:209.en:
$$テッサ$$
「One is the Iota wave that contaminated the residents of $$ヤムスク１１$$... It weakens as distance and time increase.」

544:t_2:210.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The other is the Tau wave, a kind of mental wave that, regardless of distance and time, propagates far away without weakening.」

544:t_2:211.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The Tau wave did almost no harm to ordinary people, but it is thought to have spread across the entire Earth.」

544:t_2:212.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But no one noticed... is that it?」

544:t_2:213.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes, because it could not be observed physically. But there were exceptions.」

544:t_2:214.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ went out of control on December 24, 18 years ago...」

544:t_2:215.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's... the day I was born...!」

544:t_2:216.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It is also the birthday of $$レナード$$ and me... and of $$バニ$$ and $$ミラ$$.」

544:t_2:219.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Because $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ went out of control, the Tau wave spread around the world for about three minutes 18 years ago.」

544:t_2:221.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Those children are us... the $$ウィスパード$$.」

544:t_2:222.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So during those three minutes, a huge amount of knowledge called Black Technology got into our heads?」

544:t_2:223.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That is not quite how it works.」

544:t_2:224.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I believe we were given the ability to receive other mental waves sent from some future through the $$オムニ・スフィア$$.」

544:t_2:226.en:
$$テッサ$$
「In the $$オムニ・スフィア$$, information can sometimes travel backward through time.」

544:t_2:227.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We are not born holding unknown technical information; we are receiving information sent from the future.」

544:t_2:228.en:
$$テッサ$$
「What was imprinted at birth was probably the minimum ability needed to receive it.」

544:t_2:229.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then there are technologies and weapons born from that future technical information?」

544:t_2:230.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The most prominent example is the AS.」

544:t_2:231.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Mobile weapons born from a system entirely different from conventional technology... and the many revolutionary technologies that came with them...」

544:t_2:232.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They probably could never have existed in the original world.」

544:t_2:233.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Those little weapons... are proof of the world's distortion...」

544:t_2:234.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even among the many possibilities the $$大時空震動$$ brought about, that is an unusual one...」

544:t_2:235.en:
$$テッサ$$
「A world transformed by it should be called a time disaster... a time hazard.」

544:t_2:236.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Though I don't know whether an original history truly exists in the first place...」

544:t_2:238.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If the appearance of the $$ウィスパード$$ and the interference of the $$オムニ・スフィア$$ were inevitable, you could say it was natural for things to be this way all along.」

544:t_2:240.en:
$$かなめ$$
(A world with no AS... Then $$宗介$$ would...)

544:t_2:241.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...It may be dangerous ahead, even for a $$ウィスパード$$. $$カナメ$$, please wait here.」

544:t_2:242.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's waiting up ahead, isn't it...」

544:t_2:243.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The place that warped our fates...」

544:t_2:245.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then let's go. The two of us.」

544:t_2:251.en:
$$レナード$$
「This is how the present world came to be... in other words, the world warped by $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$'s runaway.」

544:t_2:253.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're free not to believe it.」

544:t_2:254.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is not what I want to say.」

544:t_2:255.en:
$$宗介$$
「What I'm saying is ridiculous is that you decide on your own that this world is distorted.」

ヴァロフ.evidence: Dr. Varoff, scientist behind the first TARTAROS/TAROS experiment at Yamsk-11 in Full Metal Panic!; romanisation from memory, not in glossary

バニ.evidence: Nickname of Vanilla Vartla (バニラ), a Whispered born on 12/24; not in glossary

kept_omissions: 544:t_2:242: Kaname's 'this-place-ahead is waiting' - subject (the thing/place) left as 'It' (referent revealed in t_2:243)
544:t_2:174/177: Leonard's 彼女 resolved as Kaname by scene
uncertain: ヴァロフ博士 = Dr. $$ヴァロフ$$ (Varoff): not in glossary, spelling from memory
バニ = $$バニ$$ (Bani) and ミラ = $$ミラ$$ (Mira, as in 2075_00); Bani is Vanilla's nickname, assumed
ささやき = plain 'the Whispers' (not the ウィスパリング token)
177 カナメ pun rendered 'linchpin, just as her name says'
234 それは (AS) vs world possibility: 'that is an unusual one'
